object.name: InputWidgetMessageContent
object.description: Represents the content of a message with an HTML widget to be sent as the result of an inline query. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.
object.html_description: Represents the content of a message with an HTML widget to be sent as the result of an inline query. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.
object.rst_description: Represents the `content <https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputmessagecontent>`_ of a message with an `HTML widget <https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets>`_ to be sent as the result of an inline query. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.

annotations.description: HTML code of the widget, 1-32768 bytes. The code must not exceed 4096 bytes when compressed by zlib with the maximum compression level.
annotations.html_description: HTML code of the widget, 1-32768 bytes. The code must not exceed 4096 bytes when compressed by zlib with the maximum compression level.
annotations.rst_description: HTML code of the widget, 1-32768 bytes. The code must not exceed 4096 bytes when compressed by zlib with the maximum compression level.
annotations.name: html

annotations.description: Width of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble. The width is clamped by the app to the range from 200 to the maximum width of the message bubble.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Width of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble. The width is clamped by the app to the range from 200 to the maximum width of the message bubble.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Width of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble. The width is clamped by the app to the range from 200 to the maximum width of the message bubble.
annotations.name: width

annotations.description: Height of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the height of the widget isn't fixed. The height is clamped by the app to the range 50-600.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Height of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the height of the widget isn't fixed. The height is clamped by the app to the range 50-600.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Height of the widget in logical pixels; omit if the height of the widget isn't fixed. The height is clamped by the app to the range 50-600.
annotations.name: height

annotations.description: Public data of the widget, 0-1024 bytes, which will be available wherever the widget is shown. If the widget is shared, then all messages with it will have the same public data.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Public data of the widget, 0-1024 bytes, which will be available wherever the widget is shown. If the widget is shared, then all messages with it will have the same public data.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Public data of the widget, 0-1024 bytes, which will be available wherever the widget is shown. If the widget is shared, then all messages with it will have the same public data.
annotations.name: public_data

annotations.description: Data of the widget, which is specific to the message, 0-1024 bytes
annotations.html_description: Optional. Data of the widget, which is specific to the message, 0-1024 bytes
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Data of the widget, which is specific to the message, 0-1024 bytes
annotations.name: chat_data

annotations.html_description: Optional. Widget caption, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Widget caption, 0-1024 characters after entities parsing
annotations.name: caption

annotations.html_description: Optional. Mode for parsing entities in the widget caption. See formatting options for more details.

annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Pass :code:`True` to allow the widget to send queries to the bot

annotations.description: Pass True to create a shared widget. Each message sent from the result creates a separate shared widget, whose identifier is received by the bot only in the field widget_id of queries from the widget. To send an existing shared widget in response to an inline query, use InputSharedWidgetMessageContent instead.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Pass True to create a shared widget. Each message sent from the result creates a separate shared widget, whose identifier is received by the bot only in the field widget_id of queries from the widget. To send an existing shared widget in response to an inline query, use InputSharedWidgetMessageContent instead.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*. Pass :code:`True` to create a shared widget. Each message sent from the result creates a separate shared widget, whose identifier is received by the bot only in the field *widget_id* of queries from the widget. To send an existing shared widget in response to an inline query, use :class:`aiogram.types.input_shared_widget_message_content.InputSharedWidgetMessageContent` instead.
annotations.name: is_shared
